messages:
kai: Deployed slice-8 -> prod at 20:03 UTC. Canary 10% for 30m. Commit: 9f4b2d3. Rolling out traffic policy: gradual-canary.
mee: nice, thanks. I triggered the smoke job (smoke/slice-8).
ops-bot: smoke job started: https://ci.redwood/smoke/8943 · logs streaming · ETA ~45s
sre-liz: watching host errors and p95 latency (apigw / inference). FYI alert thresholds are temporarily bumped per rollout runbook.
alex: quick check: I ran the minimal inference vector against canary: 1 request, 50 tokens, latency 220ms. no errors.
jordan: ran health-checks: /health, /ready, kvcache warmup probe all green.
qa-bot: smoke suite results: 12/12 tests passed. failing test list: none. duration 1m12s.
mee: small regression note — topk reranker response variance looked higher on one sample, leaving note in #eng-ml for trace id 0x7b4f.
sre-liz: metrics look good so far. p99 is slightly spiky on one host, isolating. Will cordon host if it repeats.
kai: roll forward plan: hold canary for 30m unless any >= Sev2 appears. rollback instructions are in the runbook.
alex: pushing a tiny patch for a header mis-emit (PR #4128). If CI passes, we can queue minor rollout to remaining slices after hold.
mee: re: PR #4128 — please add a unit test for header shape, otherwise I won't unblock.
alex: ack, adding test now.
ops-bot: metric snapshot (20:10 UTC): errors 0.02%, request rate 4.8k RPS, avg token/sec 1.1k. snapshot id: ms-2968504400
qa-bot: recomputed golden prompts eval against canary — no quality regression within thresholds. details: https://evals.redwood/reports/2968
sre-liz: still seeing one host p99 bump tied to GPU mem pressure, moving a batch away from that node. no user impact observed.
kai: thanks all. if no objections after the 30m hold, we'll promote to 100% at 20:34 UTC. tagging oncall for visibility: @sre-liz. :thumbsup:
mee: small follow-up: adding quick smoke-verifier to post-deploy job so next time it's automatic. created ticket INF-2381.
jordan: noted for the deployment retro — add a checklist step to run `./infra/tools/cache-warm --slice=8` before canary in future.
alex: CI green, PR #4128 merged to main. will watch for any downstream fallout.
kai: final: promote at 20:34 unless someone objects. leaving this thread open for any late signals.
